judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements usage accumulation across provider calls, handles missing round usage without poisoning totals, and updates the specs and CHANGELOG thoroughly. However, it misses the acceptance criterion requiring the hook's type signature to make the aggregation unambiguous (`totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` on `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse`), even leaving that facet unchecked in its own `.lore/dod.md` artifact (which itself should not be committed). Additionally, the candidate places the new helper in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` and creates a separate acceptance test file, whereas the reference keeps the helper internal to `chatOrchestrator.ts`, adds the tests directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and updates the main section of `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of the out-of-scope section.
